items.t: Packers' Jacobs says TD celebration that drew criticism was modeled after a gospel song
items.x: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs says he was paying homage to a gospel song rather than making light of his recent arrest when he briefly had his hands behind his back while celebrating a touchdown Thursday night.

items.t: 3 killed in helicopter collision that shut down part of an Oregon highway
items.x: Two helicopters collided near a small airport southwest of Portland, Oregon, killing all three people aboard.

items.t: Kings beat Senators 6-5 in OT after blowing a 4-goal lead in the 3rd period
items.x: Quinton Byfield scored at 3:37 of overtime and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Ottawa Senators 6-5 on Thursday night after blowing a four-goal lead in the third period.

items.t: 3 dead in Oregon helicopter collision, including flight instructor and student pilot
items.x: Photos show the aftermath of a deadly helicopter collision in near an Oregon airport.

items.t: Police said Sandra Birchmore's death was a suicide. Then the FBI accused a cop of murder.
items.x: A former Massachusetts police detective is being tried on charges that he killed a pregnant woman to hide that he had begun sexually abusing her when she was 15.

items.t: A midterm crossroads for both parties eyeing the beginning of the end of the Trump era
items.x: The nation’s major political parties are at a crossroads.

items.t: Vote Republican, or else: How Trump is dangling government help on the campaign trail
items.x: President Donald Trump is signaling to states that his administration may be far less likely to help if their voters put Democrats in power on Election Day.

items.t: G20 diplomats, including from China and Russia, face deep rifts as they prepare to meet in Atlanta
items.x: Top diplomats from the G20, the group of the world's largest economies, are meeting in Atlanta as they face deep rifts over global crises that threaten international security and trade.

items.t: McDonald’s is bringing back Pokémon Happy Meals with mini box toys and trading cards
items.x: McDonald's will bring Pokémon back to the Happy Meal on Nov. 10, with a collection built around the franchise's 30th anniversary.

items.t: Love throws 3 TD passes as the Packers beat the Panthers 27-19
items.x: Jordan Love threw three touchdown passes, Josh Jacobs scored twice and the Green Bay Packers withstood three turnovers to defeat the Carolina Panthers 27-19 on Thursday night.

items.t: Jacksonville woman removed from city meeting for political shirt claims her rights were violated
items.x: The woman was handcuffed and removed for wearing a political shirt at Tuesday's meeting. City officials say rules prohibit political campaigning during meetings.

items.t: Yulee Elementary teacher terminated after student says he spit on him; mother seeks charges
items.x: "Nobody is above the law," his mom, Peggy Quartman, said. "You cannot do that. He is a child, he didn't ask to go to school and be disrespected."

items.t: Fanfiction website AO3 could be down for 'up to four weeks' after security incident
items.x: The organization that runs Archive of Our Own, a massive fanfiction website, says the site might be down for up to four weeks.

items.t: Prep work begins for next phase of Cabot/Koppers Superfund cleanup in Gainesville
items.x: Work is starting on the next phase of cleanup at the Cabot/Koppers Superfund site in Gainesville. According to Alachua County, this week marks the start of prep work.

items.t: Firefighters to host benefit luncheon for colleague battling cancer
items.x: Alachua and Gilchrist County firefighters are hosting a benefit luncheon for a colleague who is battling cancer that has moved to his bones.

items.t: $3M state grant to fund Suwannee River Water Management District land purchase
items.x: A $3 million state grant is going to the Suwannee River Water Management District for a land deal.

items.t: Schaefer scores his 2nd goal of the game in OT to lift Islanders past Wild, 4-3
items.x: Matthew Schaefer scored his second goal of the game on a wrist shot at 33 seconds of overtime to give the New York Islanders a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Thursday night.

items.t: Midterm candidates say they are winning voters across party lines
items.x: Some midterm election candidates have recently been promoting their ability to win over voters from across party lines but experts say it may not be enough to change outcomes in November.

items.t: Justice Department issues new subpoenas over Alaska candidate controversy, AP source says
items.x: The Justice Department issued subpoenas in an investigation over an Alaska Senate candidate who shares a name with GOP incumbent Dan Sullivan, an AP source says.

items.t: Family of 19-year-old killed in Jacksonville apartment shooting files wrongful death lawsuit
items.x: Eight months after a teenager was shot and killed inside his apartment, his family is taking legal action against the apartment complex.
